title: Chick-Fil-A Kale Salad (Copycat Recipe!)
summary: I love making my own Chick-fil-A kale salad at home. This copycat recipe uses fresh kale, cabbage, and a tangy apple dijon vinaigrette.
ingredients: ½ cup extra virgin olive oil
steps: Prepare the dressing by adding all ingredients into a glass jar, screw the lid on tightly and shake vigorously to combine. Alternatively, you can whisk all ingredients in a bowl.
Set dressing aside and prepare the salad by washing and removing the kale leaves from the stems.
Roughly chop the kale and place in a mixing bowl.
Drizzle ½ of the salad dressing over top.
Using clean hands, massage to soften the kale.
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes - 1 hour.
When ready to serve add the roasted almonds, reserving some to sprinkle on top, and toss to combine. Add more dressing if desired.
